title: Which Failure Does an Intervention Repair? When Agent Interventions Help, and Where Self-Evolving Skills Stall
abstract: arXiv:2611.29290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An intervention that improves one agent can break another, and adding a stronger harness on top need not repair the damage. Agent interventions such as skills, harnesses, and extra inference budget are nonetheless usually credited with one average gain, measured under one setup. We ask instead when each intervention helps and which failure it repairs. A matched factorial study over nine benchmarks, four models, four skill conditions, four harness levels, and three budgets, with nearly 0.9 million trajectories, changes one axis at a time. No configuration is best everywhere, interventions interact rather than add, and a harness can absorb a skill's gain, rescue a failure the skill causes, or leave the gain intact. The failure left by the current system points to the fix: missing knowledge to a stronger model, execution errors to a richer harness. translated_title: 干预修复的是哪种失败？智能体干预何时有效，自进化技能又何时停滞
translated_abstract: 一项能改善某个智能体的干预措施可能会破坏另一个智能体，而在此基础上叠加更强的框架也未必能修复损害。技能、框架和额外推理预算等智能体干预措施，通常只被归功于在单一设置下测得的一个平均增益。我们转而追问：每种干预何时有效，以及它究竟修复了哪种失败。一项匹配的因子分析研究涵盖九个基准、四个模型、四种技能条件、四个框架层级和三种预算，共近90万条轨迹，每次只改变一个维度。结果显示：没有哪种配置在所有情况下都是最优的；干预措施之间是相互作用而非简单叠加；框架可能吸收技能的增益、挽救技能导致的失败，或使增益保持不变。当前系统遗留的失败类型指向了对应的修复手段：知识缺失应换用更强的模型，执行错误应采用更丰富的框架。然而反馈并不等于恢复：匹配的恢复机制主要修复的是那些留下可见……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过覆盖九大基准、四个模型与近90万条轨迹的匹配因子实验，系统揭示了智能体干预（技能、框架、推理预算）之间存在交互而非简单叠加效应，并证明应根据系统遗留的失败类型（知识缺失对应更强模型、执行错误对应更丰富框架）来选择修复手段。
en_tdlr: Through a matched factorial study spanning nine benchmarks, four models, and nearly 0.9 million trajectories, this paper shows that agent interventions (skills, harnesses, budgets) interact rather than add, and that the type of residual failure—missing knowledge versus execution errors—indicates which intervention will repair it.
